final_text: Final answer: The public application shown on the home page is Bulletproof React, a team discussions app. It showcases best practices for building React applications. Users can create an account for their team, then read and take part in team-scoped discussion threads with comments. The app features two roles: USER (regular member) who can create comments in discussions and delete their own comments, and ADMIN who can create, edit, and delete discussions, comment, delete any comment, and view the team's users list.
